description: This file defines a factory function to build CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) controllers for Mongoose models in a multi-tenant environment. It includes functions for validating sorting parameters, implementing in-memory micro-caching, sanitizing payloads, merging filters with tenant enforcement, and handling errors. The generated controllers provide endpoints for listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting documents with tenant-aware filtering and error handling.

methods.name: validateSort(sort, allowed = ['timestamp', 'created_at', '_id'])
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the sort string against a whitelist to prevent heavy in-memory sorts. Supports formats like 'field' or '-field'. Defaults to '-timestamp' if invalid.

methods.name: clampLimit(limit, max = 500)
methods.description: Enforces a maximum page size limit to prevent large responses. Defaults to 20 or the provided max limit.

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value from the in-memory micro-cache if it hasn't expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Stores a value in the micro-cache with a TTL defined by environment variable or default.

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Constructs a stable cache key for list requests to enable micro-caching.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant(req)
methods.description: Sanitizes incoming create/update payloads by ensuring they are objects, removing client-provided tenant IDs, and injecting tenantId from request context.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant(filter, tenantId)
methods.description: Merges user-provided filter with tenant enforcement filters by removing tenant hints from the filter and adding a normalized tenant filter, respecting cross-tenant access restrictions.

methods.name: mapAndReplyError(res, err, context = 'operation')
methods.description: Maps known Mongoose errors to user-friendly HTTP failure responses and sends them.

methods.name: buildCrudController(Model, listDefaultSort = '-timestamp')
methods.description: Factory function that creates a REST controller for a Mongoose model, providing methods for listing (with caching, filtering, sorting, pagination), retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting documents with tenant enforcement and error handling.
